title: TreeBlueprint
description: A proposed directory tree. v1 is generated from intake + template. v2 is generated after L1-L4 ingestion of the corpus. Templates are blueprints with version=='template'.

blueprint_version.description: template = ships with the product. v1 = derived from IntakeSpec only. v2 = revised after corpus ingestion.

root_label.description: Human label for the root, e.g. 'LATAM Case'. Not the filesystem path.

intake_spec_ref.description: Path or id of the IntakeSpec that produced this.

previous_blueprint_ref.description: When kind=='corpus_refinement', the v1 this revises.

corpus_signals_used.description: Names of corpus-derived inputs that fed v2 generation. For provenance.

notes.description: Free-text explanation. For v2, MUST explain why the structure differs from v1.

path.description: Relative path segment from parent. e.g. 'INCIDENT_2024-04-04'. Must not contain '/' or '..'.

purpose.description: One-sentence statement of what this directory holds. Becomes the first paragraph of the folder README.

required.description: Soft-required marker. UI warns the user if they delete a required folder, but allows override.

expected_contents.description: Bullet list of file kinds expected here. Becomes a section in the README.

naming_convention.description: How files inside should be named, if applicable. e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD_<source>_<kind>.<ext>'.

pipeline_layers.description: Which Discovery layers this directory should run by default. Final config lives in pipeline_plan.json.

pipeline_hints.description: Hints fed to the pipeline modules for this directory.

language_hint.description: ISO-639-1 code if known (pt, es, en).

tags.description: Arbitrary tags. Used for cross-cutting filters (e.g. 'jurisdiction:CL', 'incident:2024-07-05').

readme_seed.description: Optional seed body for README.md. If absent, README is generated from purpose + expected_contents + pipeline_layers.
